record.question: Which of the following was an immediate result of the French Revolution?
options: Christianity became the official state religion of France, and from there it spread across the world.
Democracy was introduced across all countries around the globe.
The Catholic Church lost power and cathedrals were desecrated by Christians themselves.
The French established colonial rule over a majority of Europe which lasted till the end of the 18th century.
